cards.back:
A place where wild animals live for people to see.
Bahasa Indonesia: kebun binatang
Example: We visit the zoo on Saturday.
cards.say: zoo. A place where wild animals live for people to see. We visit the zoo on Saturday.

cards.back:
A person who looks after the animals at a zoo.
Bahasa Indonesia: penjaga kebun binatang
Example: The zookeeper feeds the lions.
cards.say: zookeeper. A person who looks after the animals at a zoo. The zookeeper feeds the lions.

cards.back:
A very big grey animal with a trunk.
Bahasa Indonesia: gajah
Example: The elephant sprays water with its trunk.
cards.say: elephant. A very big grey animal with a trunk. The elephant sprays water with its trunk.

cards.back:
The long nose of an elephant.
Bahasa Indonesia: belalai
Example: The elephant lifts a log with its trunk.
cards.say: trunk. The long nose of an elephant. The elephant lifts a log with its trunk.

cards.back:
A tall animal with a long neck and spots.
Bahasa Indonesia: jerapah
Example: The giraffe eats leaves from the tall tree.
cards.say: giraffe. A tall animal with a long neck and spots. The giraffe eats leaves from the tall tree.

cards.back:
An animal like a horse with black and white stripes.
Bahasa Indonesia: zebra
Example: The zebra has black and white stripes.
cards.say: zebra. An animal like a horse with black and white stripes. The zebra has black and white stripes.

cards.back:
A big animal that lives in rivers and has a huge mouth.
Bahasa Indonesia: kuda nil
Example: The hippo sleeps in the water.
cards.say: hippo. A big animal that lives in rivers and has a huge mouth. The hippo sleeps in the water.

cards.back:
A big animal with a horn on its nose.
Bahasa Indonesia: badak
Example: The rhino has a big horn.
cards.say: rhino. A big animal with a horn on its nose. The rhino has a big horn.

cards.back:
A wild cat that lives in a group called a pride.
Bahasa Indonesia: singa
Example: The lion roars loudly at night.
cards.say: lion. A wild cat that lives in a group called a pride. The lion roars loudly at night.

cards.back:
A big cat with orange fur and black stripes.
Bahasa Indonesia: harimau
Example: The tiger walks slowly in its cage.
cards.say: tiger. A big cat with orange fur and black stripes. The tiger walks slowly in its cage.

cards.back:
A big strong animal with thick fur.
Bahasa Indonesia: beruang
Example: The bear sleeps in its den.
cards.say: bear. A big strong animal with thick fur. The bear sleeps in its den.

cards.back:
A black and white bear that eats bamboo.
Bahasa Indonesia: panda
Example: The panda eats green bamboo.
cards.say: panda. A black and white bear that eats bamboo. The panda eats green bamboo.

cards.back:
An animal that hops and carries its baby in a pouch.
Bahasa Indonesia: kanguru
Example: The kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.
cards.say: kangaroo. An animal that hops and carries its baby in a pouch. The kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.

cards.back:
A big ape with long red hair, found in Indonesia.
Bahasa Indonesia: orang utan
Example: The orangutan lives in the forests of Borneo.
cards.say: orangutan. A big ape with long red hair, found in Indonesia. The orangutan lives in the forests of Borneo.

cards.back:
A very strong big ape.
Bahasa Indonesia: gorila
Example: The gorilla beats its chest.
cards.say: gorilla. A very strong big ape. The gorilla beats its chest.

cards.back:
A black and white bird that cannot fly but can swim.
Bahasa Indonesia: pinguin
Example: The penguin swims very fast.
cards.say: penguin. A black and white bird that cannot fly but can swim. The penguin swims very fast.

cards.back:
A long animal with no legs.
Bahasa Indonesia: ular
Example: The snake slides along the ground.
cards.say: snake. A long animal with no legs. The snake slides along the ground.

cards.back:
A big reptile with a long mouth and sharp teeth.
Bahasa Indonesia: buaya
Example: The crocodile lies in the river.
cards.say: crocodile. A big reptile with a long mouth and sharp teeth. The crocodile lies in the river.

cards.back:
Living in nature, not looked after by people.
Bahasa Indonesia: liar
Example: Tigers are wild animals.
cards.say: wild. Living in nature, not looked after by people. Tigers are wild animals.

cards.back:
Not safe, it can hurt you.
Bahasa Indonesia: berbahaya
Example: The lion is a dangerous animal.
cards.say: dangerous. Not safe, it can hurt you. The lion is a dangerous animal.

cards.back:
A piece of paper that lets you go in.
Bahasa Indonesia: karcis atau tiket
Example: We buy a ticket for the zoo.
cards.say: ticket. A piece of paper that lets you go in. We buy a ticket for the zoo.
